business_summary.text: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited (formerly Tata Motors Limited) is an Indian passenger vehicle manufacturer with a portfolio of ICE, CNG and EV models under the Tata brand, and owns Jaguar Land Rover, a UK-based luxury vehicle maker.

call_points.text: Targeting GBP1.7 billion of savings over two years through enterprise cost-out missions to bring breakeven down to 300k units.
JLR FY27 guidance will be shared at the Investor Day on 17 June 2026.
JLR investment spend planned at £18bn over five years from FY24.
JLR targets £1.7bn of cumulative savings over two years from Enterprise Missions.
JLR aims to reduce break-even volumes towards 300k in two years.
JLR Q4 cash balance £2.8bn; total liquidity £6.9bn including undrawn facilities.
Iran conflict impacting fuel prices and consumer confidence.

operating_notes.text: April 2026 total sales stood at 59,701 units, up 31.1% YoY.
FY26 consolidated net debt stood at ₹30.7K Cr after adverse free cash flows the release attributes to JLR production stoppages.
Tata PV FY26 revenue ₹58,465 Cr (+49.4%) with EBITDA margin 9.4%; JLR revenue £6,870 mn, down 11.1%, EBITDA margin 14.0%.
Q4FY26 consolidated free cash flow was ₹11.4K Cr as JLR operations recovered post the cyber incident.
JLR Q4 wholesales 95.3K, up 61.1% QoQ from 59.1K.
Tata PV Q4 EBITDA margin 9.4%, up 150 bps YoY.
JLR total liquidity £6.9bn including £1.7bn undrawn RCF.
Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue reached ~₹105,000 Cr with FCF of ₹11,000 Cr.
May 2026: PV domestic 59,090 units (+42% YoY), PV IB 700 units (+45%), EV domestic+IB 10,517 units (+85%, a new monthly high).
May 2026: VAHAN registrations up 50%+ YoY; company says it is No. 2 in the PV market on registrations.
India PV monthly volume run-rate scaled above 60,000 units from 45,000-50,000 earlier; targeting closer to 70,000.
EV bookings are nearly 3.5x pre-Middle East crisis levels; EV production crossed 15,000 units in July.
JLR VME at 7.1% of sales; Range Rover, Range Rover Sport and Defender now 81% of JLR sales.
October 2026 EV sales reached 16,244 units (up 75% YoY), while international exports rose to 1,532 units.

predictions.kpi: Monthly EV sales holding above 10,000 units
India PV EBITDA margin step-up in H2
Monthly EV volumes staying above 15,000 units

timeline.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported April 2026 total sales of 59,701 units, up 31% YoY.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹105,447 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹5,783 Cr.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles approved the re-appointment of Mr Al-Noor Ramji as a Non-Executive Independent Director.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹105,447 Cr (+7.2% YoY) and FY26 revenue of ₹335,582 Cr, with FY26 EBITDA margin at 6.8% and net debt at ₹30.7K Cr.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles approved the Share-based Long Term Incentive Scheme 2026 for 50,00,000 PSUs.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited shared the Q4FY26 earnings conference call recording on May 14, 2026, via its website.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles announced registration details for its India and JLR Investor Days scheduled for June 2026.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ~₹105,000 Cr and recommended a dividend of ₹3 per share.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited’s 81st AGM scheduled for July 8, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. (IST) via video conferencing, with Record Date for final dividend set for June 19, 2026.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported May 2026 total sales of 59,790 units, up 42% YoY, with EV sales at a new monthly high of 10,517 units.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles' revised 1 June 2026 press release reported May 2026 total sales of 59,790 units, up 42% YoY, with EV sales at a new high of 10,517 units (+85%).
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Q1FY27 earnings call: India PV volumes +46% YoY, revenue ₹95,800 Cr, PBT ₹1,600 Cr; JLR wholesales -10% on legacy run-out and supplier fire.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported October 2026 total sales of 75,426 units (+23% YoY), with EV sales reaching 16,244 units (+75% YoY).
